subtitle: How zip, merge, and concat behave in Reactor, with practical examples for real pipelines.
title: Project Reactor: the difference between zip, merge and concat operation
description: In Project Reactor, combining data from multiple publishers is a daily task. This guide explains the practical differences between zip, merge, and concat, including ordering, subscription strategy, and performance trade-offs. It also covers zipWith, zipWhen, and concatWith with code examples you can apply directly in production pipelines.

subtitle: A beginner-friendly introduction to Project Reactor, covering Mono, Flux, consuming data, and subscription basics.
title: Introduction to Java Reactor: A Beginner's Guide to Reactive Programming
description: This introduction to Project Reactor explains core reactive concepts such as publishers and subscribers, the difference between Mono and Flux, and how lazy execution works. It includes practical examples for creating streams, consuming data with map, flatMap, and flatMapMany, understanding cold vs hot publishers, and triggering execution with subscribe and block methods.
